chapter.title: OF OFFENCES RELATING TO DOCUMENTSAND TO[2]*** PROPERTY MARKS

heading: Counterfeiting a property mark used by another.
text: Whoever counterfeits any [7]*** property mark used by any other person shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: The words “trade mark or” omitted by s. 135 and the Sch., ibid. (w.e.f. 25-11-1959).
